summary: Practise PEACE-based planning, fraud questioning and evidence sequencing. Build stronger interview records and case summaries. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Fraud investigative interviewing uses planned, evidence-led questions to gather and test accounts while preserving their reliability. For fraud investigators and related case professionals, this five-day course develops skills in planning PEACE interviews, sequencing evidence and clarifying witness or subject accounts. You practise mapping allegations to evidence, testing alternative explanations and documenting findings with follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who gather, test or document information during fraud investigations and related internal inquiries.
prerequisites: Intermediate-level course. Prior experience handling fraud investigations, internal case reviews or investigative interviews is expected. No programming is required. You should be able to review a basic case file and discuss evidence-handling procedures used in your workplace.
